answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in juniper and willow lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the wander graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1397 impostors cost 1430 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
